inline.afterHeadingEn: ## How to Read the Best-Sign Theory in the Data
inline.afterHeadingZh: ## 如何在数据里识别顶尖球员星座论
inline.titleEn: 5 Steps to Test Any Best-Sign Claim
inline.titleZh: 验证顶尖球员星座论的五步法
inline.altEn: Five-step sequence for testing zodiac sign claims against birth-date data and youth selection cutoffs
inline.altZh: 用生日数据和青训截止日检验足球运动员星座说法的五步流程

items.subEn: Locate the youth selection cutoff for the league or country — often January 1 in football
items.subZh: 找到该联赛或国家的青训选材截止日，足球里常是 1 月 1 日

items.subEn: Births just after the cutoff will be overrepresented among elite players, regardless of sign
items.subZh: 刚过截止日出生的人在精英球员里被高估，与星座无关

items.subEn: Translate those months into zodiac signs as a label, never as a cause of talent
items.subZh: 把这些月份翻成星座只当标签，绝不当成天赋的成因

items.subEn: Notice that the best sign changes when the cutoff changes — which rules astrology out
items.subZh: 留意截止日一变，占优的星座就跟着变，这一点把星座排除在外

items.subEn: Treat any single-sign claim about elite players as a calendar artifact, not a forecast
items.subZh: 把任何单一星座论都当作日历产物，而不是一份预言

inline.afterHeadingEn: ## the Best-Sign Theory at a Glance
inline.afterHeadingZh: ## 顶尖球员星座论速查表
inline.titleEn: Three Layers of the Birth-Month Pattern
inline.titleZh: 出生月份规律的三个层次
inline.altEn: Comparison of Relative Age Effect, cutoff dependence, and zodiac-as-label across elite soccer birth-date data
inline.altZh: 精英足球出生日期数据中相对年龄效应、截止日依赖和星座标签三个层次的对比

linesEn: Births cluster just after the age-group cutoff
More elite players born early in the selection year
linesZh: 同组里偏大的孩子更常被选中
生日集中在年龄段截止日之后
更多精英球员生于选材年度前段

linesEn: Lucky months shift when the cutoff date moves
Favored quarter follows the cutoff, not the stars
Cutoff change rules out any star-based cause
linesZh: 走运月份随截止日移动
受青睐季度跟着截止日走，不是跟着星空
截止日变动排除了星空成因

linesEn: Maps a birth month onto a sign — not a cause
A sign looks lucky only because of the calendar
Pattern vanishes when corrected for age bands
linesZh: 把出生月份映射成星座，而非成因
某星座显得走运只是因为日历
校正年龄段后规律就消失
